environment.description: Identical ECS Fargate deployment but the ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with the following configuration: (1) A custom rule with priority 1 using a RegexPatternSet match on the query string component with transformation URL_DECODE applied, pattern matching any value for the 'order' query parameter that contains characters outside [a-zA-Z,_ ] — specifically the regex ^(ASC|DESC)$ is used as an allow-list via a NOT match (blocks if order param does NOT match ^(ASC|DESC)$, case-insensitive), action BLOCK with 403 response; (2) A second custom rule with priority 2 that inspects the URI path and query string with SQL_INJECTION_MATCH using sensitivity level HIGH with transformations URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE applied to all query parameters, action BLOCK; (3) A scope-down statement on rule 2 that only applies to requests where the URI path begins with /api/. Both rules use the default BLOCK action returning a static 403 with custom response body 'request-blocked'. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled per-rule with sampled requests.

rule_1.name: order-param-allowlist
rule_1.match: RegexPatternSet on query string 'order' parameter, NOT match against ^(ASC|DESC)$ (case insensitive)

rule_2.name: sqli-detection-high
rule_2.match: SqliMatchStatement with sensitivity HIGH on all query parameters
